input.quote: d. Ownership. Notwithstanding the license granted under section 2.1, TrueLink retains all of its ownership and license rights in the Interface.
input.rationale: The only ownership provision is Section 2(d), which preserves TrueLink's rights in the Interface (acceptable under the rule) but says nothing about our side. No clause anywhere confirms that Client retains title to Client Content, Client's Intellectual Property (a defined term at p0012 that is never operative) or borrower/loan data, and nothing addresses ownership of the results of the Support Services we pay for. Section 10(b)/(c) only makes Client's IP and "all results of the Hosting and Support Services" confidential, which is not ownership, and p0078 addresses domains and Client Content only on discontinuance of hosting. That leaves the rule's preferred and fallback positions unmet, so we insert a reciprocal ownership subsection with a licence back for any embedded TrueLink IP and an express no-joint-ownership statement. Noted but not separately flagged: Section 8(d) grants TrueLink a broad non-exclusive licence over the narrowly defined Credit Data (raw, aged repository data excluding Client Proprietary Information), which is a licence rather than an assignment and is limited by the Non-Competition Agreement; our insert is expressed to be subject to it.

ops.text: e. Client Ownership. Subject to the license granted in Section 8(d), as between the parties Client retains all right, title and interest in and to Client Content, Client's Intellectual Property, and all borrower, loan and other data submitted by or on behalf of Client or its customers through the Interface or to the Web Site, and shall own all results of the Support Services prepared for Client hereunder, which TrueLink hereby assigns to Client. Nothing in this Agreement assigns or transfers to TrueLink, or creates any joint ownership of, any of the foregoing. To the extent any TrueLink Intellectual Property is embedded in the results of the Support Services delivered to Client, TrueLink grants Client a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, modify and sublicense such materials as part of those results in Client's business.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 2(d) preserves TrueLink's ownership of the Interface, which we accept, but nothing in the Agreement confirms that we keep our own content, intellectual property and borrower data or that we own the Support Services results we pay for. We have added a reciprocal ownership provision (subject to the existing Credit Data licence in Section 8(d)) with a licence back for any embedded TrueLink IP; if you prefer, we can accept a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to the Support Services results in place of assignment.
proposal.summary: Add Client ownership of Client Content, Client IP, borrower data and Support Services results, with licence back for embedded TrueLink IP.
